beaches.name: Potamos (Epanomi)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is practised on the stretch between the beach bars and the shipwreck. A naturist directory reports nudists from about 400 m past the beach bars (Aug 2006) and midway to the shipwreck (Apr 2021); the beach-bar section is textile use and carries the municipality's Blue Flag. The municipality's Potamos page mentions no nudist section.
